{
  "score": 5,
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "scripts/lib/compat.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "medium",
      "message": "If `_ZBUILD_COMPAT_LOADED` is pre-set before the file is sourced the idempotency guard returns 0 immediately, leaving `_ZB_SED_INPLACE_ARGS` unset; `zbuild_sed_inplace` then expands an empty array, calling `sed` without `-i`, writing to stdout and leaving every targeted file silently unchanged at exit code 0.",
      "quote": "[[ -n \"${_ZBUILD_COMPAT_LOADED:-}\" ]] && return 0",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "scripts/lib/helpers.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "medium",
      "message": "If `_ZBUILD_HELPERS_LOADED` is pre-set before the file is sourced the idempotency guard returns 0 immediately, leaving `_ZB_STAT_MODE_CMD` unset; `_zb_target_mode_v` then takes the else branch and calls `stat -f '%Lp'` on a GNU host, gets a large filesystem-block integer, fails the `^[0-7]{3,4}$` check, and silently sets every file to mode 600.",
      "quote": "[[ -n \"${_ZBUILD_HELPERS_LOADED:-}\" ]] && return 0",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "scripts/lib/compat.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "medium",
      "message": "The sed probe uses `sed --version` as a proxy for GNU in-place semantics rather than testing the `-i` flag directly; any sed that accepts `--version` but requires a backup-suffix argument for `-i` will cause the probe to store `(-i)`, after which every `zbuild_sed_inplace` call either errors or corrupts the target file.",
      "quote": "if sed --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "scripts/lib/helpers.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "medium",
      "message": "The stat probe suppresses stdout and tests only the exit code; a `stat -c '%a'` that exits 0 but emits a non-octal string (vendor-patched stat, container shim) sets `_ZB_STAT_MODE_CMD=\"-c\"`, after which every `_zb_target_mode_v` call receives garbage, fails the octal check, and silently assigns mode 600 — a correct probe would capture and validate the output against the octal-mode pattern.",
      "quote": "if stat -c '%a' /dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "scripts/lib/helpers.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "low",
      "message": "When `_ZB_STAT_MODE_CMD` is unset (guard bypass or future caller outside the normal load path) the function defaults to the BSD `-f` form on a GNU host; the old code tested `ZBUILD_PLATFORM == macos` and defaulted to the GNU form for any other value, so the unset-variable regression path is strictly worse after this change.",
      "quote": "if [[ \"${_ZB_STAT_MODE_CMD:-}\" == \"-c\" ]]; then",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "docs/adr/ADR-009-platform-aware-modularity.md",
      "category": "coverage",
      "severity": "low",
      "message": "The `Enforced by` section names only `tests/unit/platform-probe-test.sh`; `tests/unit/atomic-write-cost-test.sh` carries the DSBUD-1 assertion (exactly one stat per `atomic_write`) but is not listed — DSADR-2 requires the subsection to name all enforcing tests, and `lint-adr-enforced-by.sh` checks file existence, not completeness, so the gap passes lint silently.",
      "quote": "- `tests/unit/platform-probe-test.sh` — DSPRB-1: `zbuild_sed_inplace` works when",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "test"
    }
  ]
}
